lead_fa: Arcane استاد زمان و فضا است: برست‌های ۹۰ ثانیه‌ای سنگین با [[Arcane Surge]] و چرخهٔ مدیریت Arcane Charge و Mana. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Spellslinger]] با تولید Arcane Splinter و [[Sunfury]] با Spellfire Sphere و ققنوس Arcane در پنجرهٔ Arcane Surge.

strengths: Burst damage against single and multiple targets with Arcane Surge
Decent group utility: Time Warp, Spellsteal, Polymorph, Remove Curse, Dragon's Breath
Single-target damage scales with enemy count thanks to Resonance
Great battlefield mobility: Blink, Alter Time, Shimmer/Time Walk
weaknesses: Highly dependent on the random Prismatic Bolt proc for competent damage
Little self-healing after a big hit; nearly all defensives are prevention-based (changing somewhat with Refractive Images in 12.1)

hero.recommendation: Both trees play almost identically; the spec has very little variance between them.
hero.sunfury: Spellfire Spheres and a strong Arcane Phoenix during the Arcane Surge window; mechanically differentiates itself with the backloaded cooldown effects of Arcane Soul and Ashes of Inspiration, giving a brief but potent window after Arcane Surge ends.
hero.spellslinger: Built around generating Arcane Splinters; more pink/purple Arcane aesthetics.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Arcane Mage Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/mage/arcane/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Always aim for 4 Arcane Charges when using Arcane Barrage.
Proc flow: Clearcasting enables Arcane Missiles which stacks Arcane Salvo; Barrage spends Salvo stacks for big damage.
Prismatic Bolt (new Apex) procs when spending Arcane Salvo with Barrage; it does not stack, so spend it quickly. Sync it with the 4pc (Cumulative Power, 8+ stacks).
Mana is not a real constraint this season; keep 4 Charges for best DPS.

opener: Arcane Barrage, then Touch of the Magi while it is midair
st_priority: Arcane Missiles if you have Clearcasting and less than 12 Arcane Salvo
Arcane Barrage if Arcane Soul is active
Prismatic Bolt (ideally with 8+ stacks of Cumulative Power from the 4pc)
Arcane Barrage with Clearcasting and 12+ Arcane Salvo
Arcane Barrage at 25 stacks of Arcane Salvo
Arcane Barrage if Arcane Pulse or Arcane Orb is ready, 12+ Salvo, and 5+ targets
Arcane Orb if you have less than 3 Arcane Charges
Arcane Pulse if under 3 Charges or 5+ targets (info only; not in default builds)
Arcane Barrage if out of mana
rotation.cooldowns: Arcane Surge: spends all mana, bursts 5 targets (square-root beyond), then buffs you 15s with 35% (plus hero-talent effects); pair with Touch of the Magi and Evocation planning.

gear.gearing_rules: Haste >>> Versatility = Critical Strike = Mastery; Intellect/ilvl still wins. Most BiS comes from raid (max ilvl + cantrip weapon effect). Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Primal Leywarden's Attire
tier_set.pc2: Arcane Missiles fires 1 additional Missile and deals 20% increased damage.
tier_set.pc4: Each wave of Arcane Missiles increases the damage of your next Arcane Blast, Arcane Pulse, or Prismatic Bolt by 5%, up to 40%.
tier_set.note: Restores power to Arcane Missiles and some of the Nether Precision gameplay loop; sync the 4pc buff with Prismatic Bolt.

mplus.hero_note: Spellslinger carries the Best tags in M+ and Delves; both trees play nearly identically.
tips: Arcane Surge hits 5 targets fully (square-root beyond): position so the biggest packs are in the first 5.
Resonance makes single-target damage scale with pack size; Arcane Orb + Barrage cleave into packs.
Polymorph and Remove Curse are real value in keys; Shimmer handles most movement mechanics.
